services.name: Home page
services.description: A home page built to your design, responsive on phones, tablets and desktops.

services.name: Additional page
services.description: One more page, such as About, Services or Pricing.

services.name: Prototype
services.description: A clickable mockup made before development. Review the layout and flow, then resolve feedback before the build starts.
services.note: The price is a default. Set the real price per quote.

services.name: Extra revision round
services.description: One more round of changes after the agreed revisions are used up.

services.name: CMS setup
services.description: Sets up a headless CMS so your team can edit content without changing code.

services.name: Content type
services.description: Defines one CMS content type and its fields, such as a blog post or a team member.

services.name: Listing page
services.description: Shows a collection of CMS entries, such as blog posts or projects.

services.name: Detail page
services.description: Shows one CMS entry on its own page.

services.name: Contact form
services.description: Sends form submissions to your email.
services.note: Requires an account with the email provider.

services.name: Booking form
services.description: Collects booking requests with a date, a time and contact details.

services.name: Third-party API integration
services.description: Connects the site to an external service through its API.
services.note: The price is a default. Set the real price per quote.

services.name: Payment integration
services.description: Accepts one-time payments through a payment provider.
services.note: Requires an account with the payment provider.

services.name: On-page SEO
services.description: Page titles, descriptions, headings, image text and a sitemap for every page.

services.name: Structured data
services.description: Adds schema markup so search engines can show rich results.

services.name: Analytics setup
services.description: Installs privacy-friendly analytics and sets up goals for your key actions.

services.name: Domain and DNS setup
services.description: Points your domain at the site and configures the DNS records.

services.name: Deployment
services.description: Publishes the site to production with a build pipeline, so later changes go live on their own.

services.name: Professional email setup
services.description: Creates mailboxes on your own domain and configures SPF, DKIM and DMARC.

services.name: Static site hosting
services.description: Fast global hosting for a static site, with HTTPS included.

services.name: Maintenance retainer
services.description: Updates, security checks and minor fixes after launch.

services.name: Support hour
services.description: Time for changes and questions that fall outside the maintenance retainer.

packages.name: Landing page
packages.description: A single page with a contact form, ready to launch. Good for a campaign, an event or a new business.

packages.name: Starter site
packages.description: A five page site with a contact form and the SEO basics. Good for a small business that needs to be online.

packages.name: Content site
packages.description: A site your team can update without a developer, with a blog or project listing.

packages.name: Hosting and care
packages.description: Hosting, updates and security checks after launch.
